fieldguide.entity.the_moth.mini_moth.des:
A servant of Moth Man, summoned to do his bidding. 

Has a taste for fine cotton and a nice cup of tea. (Not really)
fieldguide.entity.the_moth.moth.descript:
A large, friendly moth that can be saddled and mounted. It is stunningly fluffy and carries weight like a champion.

It would also love to chew on your clothes and munch on your garden.
fieldguide.entity.the_moth.moth_man.desc:
A forest creature of myth and legend, the Moth Man is a portent of great suffering and despair; a harbinger of terrible things to come. 

If you slay him, perhaps this future will not come to pass.
